args.purpose: Calculate average review score excluding canceled and unavailable orders
args.sql:
SELECT AVG(OR.review_score) as avg_review_score
FROM order_reviews OR
JOIN orders O ON OR.order_id = O.order_id
WHERE O.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
